items.text: There’s a massive chasm between the power of AI models and the ultimate workflows that enterprises are trying to automate. This gap is the opportunity for the applied AI layer to fill. You need to connect the intelligence to workflows, often reengineer processes, aggregate the right context and data, allow for the right human in the loop experiences, drive change management, do domain specific evals, manage the security and governance of the data and process, and much more. We’re going to see this layer emerge in every vertical and horizontal category. items.title: The Grok @bot team asked me if I had any advice for solopreneurs
items.text: The Grok @bot team asked me if I had any advice for solopreneurs. I’ve only been doing this full time for three months, but my advice is to design your business so you can spend more time doing work you actually enjoy. There will always be choices that could make more money. But if those choices leave you doing work you don’t enjoy, then that defeats the purpose of becoming a solopreneur in the first place. Delegate that boring work to your bots instead or just don't do it :) Was super fun joining the @SpaceXAI live stream this morning, the team is still going strong here: https://t.co/u2qwydK7M8
